cover.headline: Your list didn't get the memo
cover.sub: Why algorithm changes hit your reach but not your email list, and what to build first.

intro.headline: Own the line to your fans

blocks.text: The platform decides who sees each post. When it changes the rules, **your reach changes with it**, and nobody asks you.
Post for discovery, but don't count followers as an audience you can reach on demand.

left.title: Feed
left.text: Shown to some followers, ranked by the app.

right.title: Email
right.text: Sent to every subscriber, on the day you choose.

blocks.text: Pick one email tool and one signup form this week.
People sign up for a reason: an **early listen**, a presale code, a show alert for their city.
Put the signup offer in the first line of your bio, not the third.

slides.headline: The list is where sales happen

blocks.text: Presales, merch drops and tickets go to the list first. It's an audience **no update can throttle**.
Email the list every release week, even with nothing to sell. Keep it warm.
